title: Cards remember when they were made and when they last changed
notes: Shipped. A card carries `createdAt` and `updatedAt`, both ISO, both absent rather than null when nobody knows — a board written before the fields existed reads as unknown and stays that way, and nothing is written for a field a card does not have. `updatedAt` moves in editCard, the one funnel every field change goes through, so renaming one card does not stamp the other thirty. A move to another column ages the card; reordering a column does not. Format documented in .dashboard/CLAUDE.md and the copy in board-store.ts, pinned together by the existing test. PR #16.
